objectives.name: Mid Boss
objectives.detail: Alive in the pit from the start; killing it drops a Rejuvenator.

objectives.name: Troopers
objectives.detail: Spawn rate increases at 20:00 and 35:00; +50% max HP and larger model after 35:00.

objectives.name: Tier 1 camp
objectives.detail: Easy neutral camps across the jungle.

objectives.name: Golden Statues
objectives.detail: Tier 1 buffs at spawn; upgrades to Tier 2 at 10:00, Tier 3 at 30:00.

objectives.name: Crates
objectives.detail: Around the map; value grows over time.

objectives.name: Tier 3 camp
objectives.detail: Hard neutral camps; take 20% less melee damage.

objectives.name: Unstable Rift
objectives.detail: Opens into a capture point 20s after appearing.

resistances.name: Guardians
resistances.subtitle: Damage resistance falls as the match goes on, so they get easier to kill over time.
caveats: Spirit resist is fixed at 0% for both.
Base Guardians scale from 40% down to 20% resist per nearby enemy hero.
All Guardians take an extra -25% bullet resist specifically against players.

resistances.name: Walkers
resistances.subtitle: Damage resistance falls as the match goes on, so they get easier to kill over time.
caveats: Gains extra weapon-damage resist per nearby enemy within 51m: +20% at 3 enemies, up to +50% at 6 (multiplicative). No bonus with 1-2 enemies.

buff_stats.label: Rejuvenator duration
buff_stats.note: Team-wide buffs + instant respawns; ends early once all credits are spent.

buff_stats.label: Powerup duration
buff_stats.note: Won't always still be up for the first Rift fight, which can spawn anywhere from 11:00 to 13:00.

rules.text: Every camp (and Sinner's Sacrifice site) only starts its respawn timer once every creature in it is dead. A single survivor blocks the clock.
If a camp spawns with more than one creature tier in it (e.g. some Tier 2s plus a Tier 3), the whole camp follows the respawn timing of its highest tier.
Some sites have two Sacrifice machines guarded by an extra neutral creep. You must destroy both machines and kill that creep before the site's respawn timer starts.
The first Urn always spawns on the map's Yellow side, then alternates Yellow/Green sides each cycle. Picking it up early delays the next scheduled spawn until it's delivered or expires.
Spawns on a random side-lane bridge each time; it isn't confirmed to alternate sides.
